title: Coin Change II
contract: Count combinations of distinct positive coin denominations making amount ≥ 0. Coins may be reused; ordering coins does not create another combination.
optimal: long[] dp=new long[amount+1];dp[0]=1;for(int coin:coins){for(int value=coin;value<=amount;value++)dp[value]+=dp[value-coin];emit("Add combinations using this coin type","coin",coin,"ways",dp);}return dp[amount];
reasoning: Choose how many copies of each denomination to use, then recurse to the next denomination.
The outer coin loop establishes a canonical order of coin types, avoiding permutation overcounting.
Ascending amounts permit reuse of the current coin. Reversing the loop nesting instead counts ordered sequences, a different problem.
